verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Kaaf-haa-yaa-ayn-saad
Dhikru rahmati rabbika abdahu zakariyyaa
Idh naadaa rabbahu nidaa'an khafiyyaa
Qaala rabbi innee wahanal-azmu minnee washta'alar-ra'su shayban wa lam akun bidu'aa'ika rabbi shaqiyyaa
Wa innee khiftul-mawaaliya min waraa'ee wa kaanati imra'atee aaqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyyaa
Yarithunee wa yarithu min aali ya'qooba waj'alhu rabbi radiyyaa
Yaa zakariyyaa innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin usmuhu yahyaa lam naj'al lahu min qablu samiyyaa
Qaala rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamun wa kaanat imra'atee aaqiran wa qad balaghtu minal-kibari itiyyaa
Qaala kadhaalika qaala rabbuka huwa alayya hayyinun wa qad khalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku shay'aa
Qaala rabbi ij'al lee aayatan qaala aayatuka allaa tukalliman-naasa thalaatha layaalin sawiyyaa
Fakharaja alaa qawmihi minal-mihraabi fa-awhaa ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan wa ashiyyaa
Yaa yahyaa khudhil-kitaaba biquwwatin wa aataynaahul-hukma sabiyyaa
Wa hanaanan min ladunnaa wa zakaatan wa kaana taqiyyaa
Wa barran biwaalidayhi wa lam yakun jabbaaran asiyyaa
Wa salaamun alayhi yawma wulida wa yawma yamootu wa yawma yub'athu hayyaa
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi maryama idh intabadhat min ahlihaa makaanan sharqiyyaa
Fattakhadhat min doonihim hijaaban fa-arsalnaa ilayhaa roohanaa fatamaththala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa
Qaalat innee a'oodhu bir-rahmani minka in kunta taqiyyaa
Qaala innamaa anaa rasoolu rabbiki li'haba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa
Qaalat annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamun wa lam yamsasnee basharun wa lam aku baghiyyaa
Qaala kadhaaliki qaala rabbuki huwa alayya hayyinun wa linaj'alahu aayatan lin-naasi wa rahmatan minnaa wa kaana amran maqdiyyaa
Fahamalathu fantabadhat bihi makaanan qasiyyaa
Fa-ajaa'ahal-makhaadu ilaa jidh'in-nakhlati qaalat yaa laytanee mittu qabla haadhaa wa kuntu nasyan mansiyyaa
Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaa allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa
Wa huzzee ilayki bijidh'in-nakhlati tusaaqit alayki rutaban janiyyaa
Fakulee washrabee wa qarree aynan fa-immaa taraynna minal-bashari ahadan faqoolee innee nadhartu lir-Rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal-yawma insiyyaa
Fa-atat bihi qawmahaa tahmiluhu qaaloo yaa maryamu laqad ji'ti shay'an fariyyaa
Yaa ukhta haaroona maa kaana abooki imra'a saw'in wa maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa
Fa-ashaarat ilayhi qaaloo kayfa nukallimu man kaana fil-mahdi sabiyyaa
Qaala innee abdu Allaahi aataaniyal-kitaaba wa ja'alanee nabiyyaa
Wa ja'alanee mubaarakan ayna maa kuntu wa awsaanee bis-salaati waz-zakaati maa dumtu hayyaa
Wa barran biwaalidatee wa lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa
Was-salaamu alayya yawma wulidtu wa yawma amootu wa yawma ub'athu hayyaa
Dhaalika eesab-nu maryama qawlal-haqqil-ladhee feehi yamtaroon
Maa kaana Lillaahi an yattakhidha min waladin subhaanahu idhaa qadaa amran fa-innamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
Wa innallaaha rabbee wa rabbukum fa'budoohu haadhaa siraatun mustaqeem
Fakhtalafal-ahzaabu min baynihim fawaylun lilladheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin azeem
Asmi bihim wa absir yawma ya'toonanaa lakiniz-zaalimoonal-yawma fee dalaalin mubeen
Wa andhirhum yawmal-hasrati idh qudiyal-amru wa hum fee ghaflatin wa hum laa yu'minoon
Innaa nahnu narithul-arda wa man alayhaa wa ilaynaa yurja'oon
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi ibraaheema innahu kaana siddeeqan nabiyyaa
Idh qaala li-abeehi yaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u wa laa yubsiru wa laa yughnee anka shay'aa
Yaa abati innee qad jaa'anee minal-ilmi maa lam ya'tika fattabi'nee ahdika siraatan sawiyyaa
Yaa abati laa ta'budish-shaytaana innash-shaytaana kaana lir-Rahmaani asiyyaa
Yaa abati innee akhaafu an yamassaka adhaabun minar-Rahmaani fatakoona lish-shaytaani waliyyaa
Qaala araaghibun anta an aalihatee yaa ibraaheemu la-in lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wahjurnee maliyyaa
Qaala salaamun alayka sa'astaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kaana bee hafiyyaa
Wa a'tazilukum wa maa tad'oona min doonillaahi wa ad'oo rabbee asaa allaa akoona bidu'aa'i rabbee shaqiyyaa
Falammaa i'tazalahum wa maa ya'budoona min doonillaahi wahabnaa lahu ishaaqa wa ya'qooba wa kullaa ja'alnaa nabiyyaa
Wa wahabnaa lahum min rahmatinaa wa ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin aliyyaa
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi moosaa innahu kaana mukhlasan wa kaana rasoolan nabiyyaa
Wa naadaynaahu min jaanibit-tooril-aymani wa qarrabnaahu najiyyaa
Wa wahabnaa lahu min rahmatinaa akhaahu haaroona nabiyyaa
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi ismaa'eela innahu kaana saadiqal-wa'di wa kaana rasoolan nabiyyaa
Wa kaana ya'muru ahlahu bis-salaati waz-zakaati wa kaana inda rabbihi mardiyyaa
Wadhkur fil-kitaabi idreesa innahu kaana siddeeqan nabiyyaa
Wa rafa'naahu makaanan aliyyaa

Ulaa'ikal-ladheena an'ama Allaahu alayhim minan-nabiyyeena min dhurriyyati aadama wa mimman hamalnaa ma'a noohin wa min dhurriyyati ibraaheema wa israa'eela wa mimman hadaynaa wajtabaynaa idhaa tutlaa alayhim aayaatur-Rahmaani kharroo sujjadan wa bukiyyaa
Fakhalafa min ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us-salaata wattaba'ush-shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyaa
Illaa man taaba wa aamana wa amila saalihan fa-ulaa'ika yadkhuloonal-jannata wa laa yuzlamoona shay'aa
Jannaati adnin allatee wa-adar-Rahmaanu ibaadahu bil-ghaybi innahu kaana wa'duhu ma'tiyyaa
Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaaman wa lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratan wa ashiyyaa
Tilkal-jannatul-latee noorithu min ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa
Wa maa natanazzalu illaa bi-amri rabbika lahu maa bayna aydeenaa wa maa khalfanaa wa maa bayna dhaalika wa maa kaana rabbuka nasiyyaa
Rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumaa fa'budhu wastabir li-ibaadatihi hal ta'lamu lahu samiyyaa
Wa yaqoolul-insaanu a'idhaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju hayyaa
Awalaa yadhkurul-insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu wa lam yaku shay'aa
Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum wash-shayaateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyaa
Thumma lananzi'anna min kulli shee'atin ayyuhum ashaddu alar-Rahmaani itiyyaa
Thumma lanahnu a'lamu billadheena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa
Wa in minkum illaa wariduhaa kaana alaa rabbika hatman maqdiyyaa
Thumma nunajjil-ladheena ittaqaw wa nadharuz-zaalimeena feehaa jithiyyaa
Wa idhaa tutlaa alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo ayyul-fareeqayni khayrun maqaaman wa ahsanu nadiyyaa
Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athaathan wa ri'yaa
Qul man kaana fid-dalaalati falyamdud lahur-Rahmaanu maddan hattaa idhaa ra'aw maa yoo'adoona immal-adhaaba wa immas-saa'ata fasaya'lamoona man huwa sharrun makaanan wa ad'afu jundaa
Wa yazeedu Allaahul-ladheena ihtadaw hudan wal-baaqiyaatus-saalihaatu khayrun inda rabbika thawaaban wa khayrun maraddaa
Afara'aytal-ladhee kafara bi-aayaatinaa wa qaala la-ootayanna maalan wa waladaa
Aattala'al-ghayba am ittakhadha indar-Rahmaani ahdaa
Kallaa sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wa namuddu lahu minal-adhaabi maddaa
Wa narithuhu maa yaqoolu wa ya'teenaa fardaa
Wattakhadhoo min doonillaahi aalihatan liyakoonoo lahum izzaa
Kallaa sayakfuroona bi-ibaadatihim wa yakoonoona alayhim diddaa
Alam tara annaa arsalnash-shayaateena alal-kaafireena ta'uuzzuhum azzaa
Falaa ta'jal alayhim innamaa na'uddu lahum addaa
Yawma nahshurul-muttaqeena ilar-Rahmaani wafdaa
Wa nasooqul-mujrimeena ilaa jahannama wirdaa
Laa yamlikoonash-shafaa'ata illaa manit-takhadha indar-Rahmaani ahdaa
Wa qaalut-takhadhar-Rahmaanu waladaa
Laqad ji'tum shay'an iddaa
Takaadus-samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu wa tanshaqqul-ardu wa takhirrul-jibaalu haddaa
An da'aw lir-Rahmaani waladaa
Wa maa yanbaghee lir-Rahmaani an yattakhidha waladaa
In kullu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi illaa aatir-Rahmaani abdaa
Laqad ahsaahum wa addahum addaa
Wa kulluhum aateehi yawmal-qiyaamati fardaa
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati sayaj'alu lahumur-Rahmaanu wuddaa
Fa-innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil-muttaqeena wa tundhira bihi qawman luddaa
Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa
